note: Measured on 18 cores (6 performance + 12 efficiency). 150 cases at 2s with 8 case workers is ~50s. The 3 repeats this started with cost 3x for nothing: their spread was 0.0018 against improvement steps of 0.01-0.1, so averaging bought precision nobody needed. The 2s limit is the contest's own and is left alone -- cutting it to 0.5s buys 2.7x but drops the seed 5.7% and would reorder algorithms that spend the budget differently, which is exactly the comparison this benchmark exists to make.
